description: This 2023 Kia Sorento SX in Black delivers reliable performance and thoughtful design for today's active driver. With its turbocharged 2.5L engine, eight-speed automatic transmission, and all-wheel drive, this three-row SUV combines capability with efficiency, returning 22 city and 27 highway MPG.  - Turbocharged 2.5L I4 engine with 281 horsepower - All-wheel drive with 8-speed dual-clutch transmission - Power moonroof with automatic open/close - Heated front bucket seats with power adjustment - Navigation system with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration - Three-row seating with split-folding rear seat for flexible cargo space - Exterior parking camera with rear view display - Smart Key with push-button start and remote start capability - Automatic high-beam headlights with front fog lights - SiriusXM satellite radio with 6-speaker audio system - Electronic stability control with traction control - Four-wheel independent suspension with all-wheel disc brakes - Leather-wrapped steering wheel with mounted audio controls - Auto-dimming rear-view mirror with outside temperature display - 20-inch gloss black alloy wheels  The Sorento SX is designed with your comfort in mind. Dual-zone automatic temperature control keeps front and rear passengers comfortable, while the power-adjustable driver seat and telescoping steering wheel ensure an ideal driving position. The heating elements built into the front seats provide warmth on colder days, and the power moonroof brings natural light and fresh air into the cabin.  Technology remains accessible and practical throughout this SUV. The available technology transforms your driving experience with the 12.3" multicolor reconfigurable digital display and advanced connectivity features. Stay informed with the compass, trip computer, and outside temperature display, while managing your music and calls through steering wheel-mounted audio controls. The automatic high-beam headlights with delay-off functionality enhance visibility and convenience during night driving.  Safety remains paramount with dual front impact airbags, side impact airbags, and overhead airbags positioned throughout the cabin. The electronic stability control, traction control, and brake assist systems work together to maintain control in challenging situations. Lane Keep Assist helps prevent unintended drifting, while the Forward Collision Alert and automatic emergency braking provide additional protection.  The truck's practical features make ownership straightforward and rewarding. The power windows, doors, and mirrors respond to your commands, while the telescoping and tilt steering wheel adjusts to your preferred driving position. Illuminated entry and overhead console lighting ensure visibility whether you're loading cargo or accessing interior storage. The front-frame-mounted recovery hooks and hitch guidance simplify trailering tasks.  This vehicle represents a solid investment in a truck that balances performance, comfort, and utility. The combination of modern technology, safety features, and thoughtful design creates an environment where you'll enjoy spending time behind the wheel. Whether managing work tasks or enjoying weekend adventures, this Silverado 1500 LT LT1 is ready to serve your needs.  We invite you to visit our showroom to experience this truck firsthand and discuss how it fits into your lifestyle and goals. Road trips used to be stressful, until GPS linked cruise control set the pace. Simply set the desired speed and the system uses GPS navigation data to maintain that speed without driver intervention - including slowing down for curves and anticipating hills. This can help minimize driver fatigue and improve overall fuel economy. Meet your ultimate co-pilot; GPS linked cruise control. Distance pacing cruise control with traffic stop-go. Set it and forget it.  Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety.  Now, with Distance pacing cruise control with traffic stop-go, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and the vehicle ahead.  It's stop/go feature automatically brings the vehicle to a stop if traffic stops and  resumes distance pacing cruise when traffic starts to move again.  Distance pacing cruise control with traffic stop-go; your ultimate co-pilot.Safety and Security Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life.  When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident.  Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead. Hands-on cruise control with lane change - Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with hands-on cruise control with lane change, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles. It slows you down; speeds you up, and helps you make lane changes. Meet your ultimate co-pilot, hands-on cruise control with lane change. Lane departure prevention - Keep it between the lines. It only takes a moment of inattention for your vehicle to drift.  With lane departure prevention, your vehicle takes corrective action to help you avoid unintentionally moving out of your lane.  Lane departure prevention is an extra level of safety for you and those around you. Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety.  Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision. Rear camera - Watching your back!  The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.Technology and Telematics Internet access - Bring the world into your vehicle.
